programme.title: Modern Family

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Under Pressure: The high school open house puts the parents in a time warp when Claire gets stressed out by all the pressure. Jay teaches Phil how to play truant.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Giuseppi's: Gordon Ramsay visits a family-owned Italian in Michigan, run by a father and son who constantly clash. Can he get the restaurant - and the family - back on track?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Handlebar: Gordon Ramsay takes on a time warp at the Handlebar restaurant and lounge in Mount Sinai, New York, where the owners are stuck in the 80s with an unenthusiastic chef.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Brand new series - Lyla's Family Restaurant (Part 1/2): Owner Waleed's American dream has turned into a full-blown Nightmare, but he's still firmly in denial...

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Frink Gets Testy: When Mr Burns panics about the apocalypse and builds a cosmic ark, Professor Frink develops a test to work out who deserves a place on it.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer Is Where the Art Isn't: Homer learns to love a Miro painting. Then it's stolen - and he gets the blame.

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: New: Lego Masters Australia
